'''Sushanta Kumar Dattagupta''', known better as '''Sushanta Dattagupta''', is an Indian [[condensed matter physicist]].<ref name="INSA">{{cite web | url=http://www.insaindia.org/detail.php?id=N94-1142 | archive-url=https://archive.today/20141029064316/http://www.insaindia.org/detail.php?id=N94-1142 | url-status=dead | archive-date=2014-10-29 | url=http://www.iiserkol.ac.in/component/sobipro/?pid=54&sid=115:Sushanta-Dattagupta&Itemid=538 | title=ISER | publisher=ISER | date=2014 | access-date=29 October 2014 | archive-date=29 October 2014 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141029160125/http://www.iiserkol.ac.in/component/sobipro/?pid=54&sid=115:Sushanta-Dattagupta&Itemid=538 | url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="SN Bose">{{cite web | url=http://www.bose.res.in/sdgupta/qualification.htm | archive-url=https://archive.today/20141029070408/http://www.bose.res.in/sdgupta/qualification.htm | url-status=dead | archive-date=2014-10-29 | title=SN Bose | publisher=SN Bose NCBS | date=2014 | access-date=29 October 2014 }}</ref><ref name="Serb.gov.in">{{cite |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130823112534/http://serb.gov.in/pdfs/research/Prof_Sushanta_Dattagupta.pdf |archive-date=23 August 2013 }}</ref><ref name="EDU Tech">{{cite web | 2014 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141029190520/http://www.edu-leaders.com/news/13739/sushanta-dattagupta-appointed-vc-visva-bharati-university?source=edu | archive-date=29 October 2014 | df=dmy-all }}</ref> He was Director of the [[S. N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences|S N Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences Kolkata]] between 1999 and 2005 and then he was appointed Program Co-ordinator by the Ministry of Human Resources and Development (MHRD) for the newly evolving system of [[Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research]] (IISER). Subsequently, in 2006 he was made the founding director of [[IISER Kolkata]]. After serving one full term there the same ministry of HRD made him the Vice-chancellor of [[Visva-Bharati University|Visva-Bharati]], which is served between September 2011 and February 2016. 

==Biography==
Sushanta Dattagupta,  was born in Kolkata, West Bengal, India on 19 December 1947<ref name="SN Bose" /> and graduated in Physics (BSc Hons), in 1965, from the [[University of Calcutta]]. His master's degree also came from the same university in 1967.  The next year, in 1968, Dr. Dattagupta joined the [[Presidency College, Kolkata]] as a lecturer in Physics where he taught for one year.<ref name="ISER" /><ref name="SN Bose" /> In 1969, Dattagupta went to the US to join the [[Brookhaven National Laboratory]] and [[St. John's University (New York City)|St. John's University]] where he did his doctoral research to obtain a PhD in Physics, in 1973.<ref name="INSA" /> He continued in North America for three more years to work as a post-doctoral fellow at the [[Carnegie-Mellon University]], Pittsburgh, USA  till 1975, and later, at the [[University of Alberta]], Canada for a year.<ref name="INSA" /><ref name="ISER" /><ref name="SN Bose" />

Dattagupta returned to India in 1976 to join the [[Materials Science Laboratory]], [[Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research]], Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu where he worked as a scientific officer till 1981. The next assignment was as the [[Reader (academic rank)|Reader]] at the School of Physics, [[University of Hyderabad]] which lasted till 1986. In 1986, Dattagupta was offered a job at the [[Jawaharlal Nehru University, Delhi|Jawaharlal Nehru University]] where he taught till 1999, first as a Professor and later as the Dean of the School of Physical Sciences.<ref name="ISER" /><ref name="SN Bose" />

He returned to his native place, Kolkata, in 1999, assuming responsibility as the director of the [[S.N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences]]<ref name="INSA" /> and worked there till 2006. This was followed by the Directorship of the [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Kolkata]] (IISER).

==Career==
When the [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Kolkata]] (IISER)<ref name="IISER">{{cite web | url=http://www.iiserkol.ac.in/ | title=IISER | publisher=IISER | date=2014 | access-date=29 October 2014 | archive-date=21 July 2011 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110721150025/http://www.iiserkol.ac.in/ | url-status=live }}</ref> was established at Mohanpur, West Bengal, in July 2006, under the aegis of the [[Ministry of Human Resource Development (India)|Ministry of Human Resource Development]], [[Government of India]], Dattagupta was its first director.<ref name="INSA" /><ref name="Serb.gov.in" /> 

He has published his research findings as several books<ref name="Sciencescape">{{cite web | url=https://sciencescape.org/author/48088831 | title=Sciencescape | publisher=Sciencescape | date=2014 | access-date=29 October 2014 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141112142301/https://sciencescape.org/author/48088831 | archive-date=12 November 2014 | df=dmy-all }}</ref><ref name="SN Bose books">{{cite web | url=http://www.bose.res.in/sdgupta/books_written.htm | title=SN Bose books | publisher=SN Bose | date=2014 | access-date=29 October 2014 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141029201600/http://www.bose.res.in/sdgupta/books_written.htm | archive-date=29 October 2014 | df=dmy-all }}</ref><ref name="Microsoft Academic Search">{{cite web | url=http://academic.research.microsoft.com/Search?query=Sushanta%20Kumar%20Dattagupta | title=Microsoft Academic Search | publisher=Microsoft Academic Search | date=2014 | access-date=29 October 2014 | archive-date=26 November 2014 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141126132536/http://academic.research.microsoft.com/Search?query=Sushanta%20Kumar%20Dattagupta | url-status=dead }}</ref> and published nearly 200 articles.<ref name="ISER" /><ref name="Serb.gov.in" />

Dattagupta has also attended several national and international seminars to deliver keynote addresses.<ref name="Tatkal News">{{cite web | url=http://www.tatkalnews.com/photo-gallery/1334-Vishva-Bharati-University-San.aspx | title=Tatkal News | publisher=Tatkal News | date=29 October 2014 | access-date=29 October 2014 | archive-date=29 October 2014 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141029163630/http://www.tatkalnews.com/photo-gallery/1334-Vishva-Bharati-University-San.aspx | url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="Seminar">{{cite web | url=http://www.u.tsukuba.ac.jp/~tokura.yasuhiro.ft/Meetings/Seminars.html | title=Seminar | publisher=University of Tsukuba | date=2013 | access-date=29 October 2014 | archive-date=29 October 2014 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141029215826/http://www.u.tsukuba.ac.jp/~tokura.yasuhiro.ft/Meetings/Seminars.html | url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Positions==
Dattagupta has held many positions, both on academic and organizational levels.<ref name="SN Bose contribs">{{cite web | url=http://www.bose.res.in/sdgupta/contribution.htm | title=SN Bose contribs | publisher=SN Bose | date=2014 | access-date=29 October 2014 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141029202255/http://www.bose.res.in/sdgupta/contribution.htm | archive-date=29 October 2014 | df=dmy-all }}</ref> He was the Foreign Secretary and Vice President of the [[Indian National Science Academy]] between 1998 and 2001, Vice President of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], Bangalore during 2004-2009 and a council member of the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]], Allahabad from 2001 to 2014. He was elected Fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences|The World Academy of Sciences (TWAS)]], Trieste, Italy in 1999. He has held the chair of the national committees of the Indian National Science Academy for International Council of Science (ICSU) and [[Council for Scientific and Industrial Research]] and was the vice chairman of ''STATPHYS 22'', an International Conference on Statistical Physics held in Bangalore in July 2004.<ref name="SN Bose contribs" /> he served as the Convener of the sectional committee on Physical Sciences of the Indian Academy of Sciences, Bangalore during 1999-2003.<ref name="SN Bose contribs" /> He was also a member of [[CSIR India|CSIR]] Emeritus Scientists Committee during 2002-04, research council of the [[National Physical Laboratory of India|National Physical Laboratory]] during 2001-06 and the membership committee of the Third World Academy of Sciences (TWAS) during 2004-06.<ref name="SN Bose contribs" />
